prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, early 50s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other; every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass, the sheer weight of the flesh visible in how it spills forward and settles, her body so wide that her hips nearly touch the left and right edges of the frame; real photographic skin with visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, hair coloured vivid copper-orange worn as countless fine micro braids — full body liquid polished silver poured and set directly over her own skin covering EVERY inch of skin from neck down to the top edge of her boots WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered down to the top edge of her boots, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is real molten polished silver that has flowed down every curve and hardened in place into a smooth mirror-bright skin of metal, each pooled ridge and flowing run standing in true three-dimensional relief, catching its own bright reflection and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense flowing metal — BLAZING mirror-bright liquid polished silver streams pooling and hardening across the full torso both legs neck down to the top edge of her boots, VIVID cool steel-grey reflections gathering in every crease filling every remaining gap with real depth, each ridge glossy and rounded exactly like real poured metal, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing perfectly upright and tall in a pointe stance with both legs pressed together and arms relaxed at her sides, looking straight at the camera — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: the most absurdly extreme ballet boots in solid silver metallic leather with a rigid sharply pointed toe box encasing the whole foot like a ballerina's pointe shoe, each with a razor-thin tapered heel spike attached to the back of the boot behind the ankle and angled backward, NOT touching the floor, NO platform and NO thick sole anywhere under the foot, her feet arched fully vertical with the tip of each pointed toe resting directly on the floor like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long in one unbroken vertical line straight down to the floor.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, round nails each as long as her forearm is wide, coated in the same liquid polished silver with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT metal — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a blurred ink-black gradient across the lids like soft smoke, a fine black liner, natural full lashes, a glass-skin highlight on the cheekbones, ink-black glossy lips with a softly blurred gradient edge.

Background: a sunny plaza at the foot of glass skyscrapers with pale paving, a low fountain edge, standard-height glass doors and benches, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, soft beauty dish light, even flattering illumination, serene tranquil mood, peaceful calm atmosphere, meditative editorial, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck down to the top edge of her boots. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her extreme height reads at a glance, the tip of each pointed boot clearly touching the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
